Scope: Production CLR FishYieldSelection normalizes each retained positive selected resource once into immutable ordered capture products. TID is distinct from the selected lookup ID; captured raw grade and float-derived per-product weights are held separately from unverified return FinalGrade. The typed native adapter supports exact DR.Items resources and ordered one-shot virtual getters, compiled without a GUI/network producer. TrySeal passes only the cached batch to the existing ledger with caller-supplied fresh facts; it does not fabricate evidence or capture receipts. 10 new synthetic-backend production coordinator/ledger fixtures and all 246 Core/TCP tests actually ran, as did warning-as-error compilation. The new private original metadata report covers three types/fourteen getter declarations; one new offline PE report covers one method/112 known-range instructions. No native getter execution/ABI, complete gameplay yield, member ownership, personal capacity/materialization, fish terminal receipt, storage/save, guest isolation, host world or two-game return is verified. Full M3-M7 and cold configuration remain required.
